content:
Maya: 🎉 Heads-up — dashboard just hit 1,250,000 inference requests in the last 24h. quietly losing my voice from cheering
Oliver: holy smokes :eyes: that's wild. when did the spike start?
Maya: started ~08:10 PT, sustained for ~2h, peak ~`9.2k r/s` on the serving side. graphs look clean.
Devon: team win!!! :tada: we should do a tiny IRL thing? courtyard meet + snacks?
Sophia: poll idea: ice cream truck 🍦, sushi-burrito truck 🍣, or hot chocolate bar ☕ — vote with emoji and I'll coordinate ordering. i'll aim for vegan options regardless.
Carlos: 🍦 for me (+:thumbsup:) — can we ensure vegan/soy sorbet?
Linda: sushi-burrito sounds amazing and portable, but also +vegan please :raised_hands:
Ben: ☕ hot chocolate bar from me — i'll bring marshmallows and reusable mugs.
ops-bot: Calendar event created: "1.25M Requests — Courtyard Celebration" at 15:00 PT for 30m. RSVP with :raised_hand:.
Maya: tiny non-work shoutout: infra handled the load perfectly. zero incident flips during the surge :clap:
Oliver: can we sneak a 10-min lightning demo showing the perf chart in the middle of the meetup? quick before dessert?
Sophia: yes pls. also @Devon @Carlos huge shoutout for the kernel fallback tweak that made those tail latencies behave.
Devon: thanks! it was a frantic 2am tweak but paid off.
Linda: poll so far: 🍦 4, 🍣 2, ☕ 3 — ice cream is edging ahead. will keep open for 1h.
Ben: i'll bring spoons + cups + a stack of napkins. eco-friendly utensils if people want.
Maya: anyone fancy making a celebratory GIF for the all-hands slide deck tomorrow? i can try but my GIF skills are questionable.
Oliver: i made a terrible one, uploading now — [giphy:confetti-blob] :sweat_smile:
Maya: perfect. OK team — see you at 15:00 in the courtyard. quick, loud, and sugary. thanks all ❤️
